title: Yaakov Hadayva (or Chadayva)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Bava Batra 26b, where he asked Rav Chisda a question. Rashi explains that he was from Chadayev.[^1]

notes.text: בעי מרב חסדא has Yaakov asking Rav Chisda, not the reverse. כו: gives Bava Batra 26b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. Hadayva/Chadayva are source alternatives; the from-Chadayev gloss remains attributed to Rashi as Hyman reports it. Yaakov has no supplied title; Chisda’s Rav is full.
